settings.title: Countdown Timer Settings
settings.enabled-desc: When enabled, the countdown timer will be visible to visitors.
settings.countdown-title-desc: The heading displayed above the countdown.
settings.message-desc: A short message displayed below the title.
settings.end-date-desc: The exact date and time (with seconds) when the countdown ends.
settings.display-mode-desc: How the countdown timer is displayed on the website.
settings.cover-info: Cover mode blocks the entire website for visitors. The login page is always accessible so administrators can still log in.
settings.show-admin-login-desc: Display a link to the admin login page at the bottom of the cover.
settings.cover-dismissable-desc: Allow visitors to close the cover and browse the website.
settings.cover-scope-desc: Choose where the cover is displayed.
settings.page-path-desc: The URL path where the countdown page will be accessible.
settings.page-path-info: The countdown page will be accessible at: {url}
settings.show-in-nav-desc: Display a link to the countdown page in the site navigation bar.
settings.nav-link-text-desc: Custom text for the navigation link. Leave empty to use the countdown title.
settings.theme-desc: Choose the visual style for the countdown display.
settings.countdown-style-desc: Choose how the countdown numbers are displayed.
settings.bg-image-desc: Upload an image to use as the countdown background.
settings.show-logo-desc: Display the website logo on the countdown.
settings.logo-size-desc: Choose the display size for the website logo.
settings.show-server-ip-desc: Display the Minecraft server IP address on the countdown.
settings.opening-effect-desc: Play a celebration effect when the countdown reaches zero.
settings.action-hide-desc: Automatically hide the countdown and restore normal site access.

timer.default-message: Our website is getting ready. Stay tuned!
